checks.message: Direction-model boundary is explicitly provisional and excluded from official or precise use.
All three key-area envelopes are provisional, anchored to public place references, and require official replacement.
North, middle and south narratives use publicly traceable Qinghe, Wudaokou and Dazhongsi anchors without claiming surveyed boundaries.
Concept land-use cells derive from one site geometry, do not overlap, and cover the submitted boundary.
Known spatial model metrics are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from submitted geometry.
No field survey was conducted; all 30 desk-observation register rows state field_verified=false and three field-verification routes are documented in proposal.md.
Scenario cards include data minimization, human review, non-digital alternatives, complaints, audit and exit for China-based operation.
Static offline HTML uses only local figures and contains no remote or active content.
Proposal cites sources, standards, depth items, geometry and all known metrics.
Programmatic figures, ODbL attribution and source/image rights boundaries are documented.
